name: Bat
appearance: A tiny bat with a mouse-like body and thin skin stretched between its wing bones.

habitats: Warm humid areas, caves, dark buildings, and damp crevices

Group behavior.name: Startled swarm
Group behavior.effectNote: A cornered bat may bite. Startled bats fly around in confusion. Each bat has a 1% chance per round to extinguish torches. In the swarm, spellcasters need a Wisdom check to cast and combatants take a −2 THAC0 penalty.

notes: 1–100 appearing. The table lists swarm organization. Nocturnal and omnivorous.
Common. Animal intelligence (1). Neutral. Unreliable (2–4) morale. Treasure and magic resistance Nil.
The Hit Dice line gives 1–2 HP. The electronic edition instead reads Unreliable (2–5) for morale. This profile uses the printed table.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, third printing (January 1994), pp. 15–16.

name: Giant Bat
appearance: A large carnivorous bat with a 3-foot body and a wingspan of 5–6 feet.

Attacks and defenses.name: Grounded bite
Attacks and defenses.effectNote: The bat must land, often on the victim, to bite. The usual bite deals 1d2 damage. The more powerful 1 HD variety makes up 10% of Giant Bats and bites for 1d4.

Attacks and defenses.name: Missile defense
Attacks and defenses.effectNote: While flying, the bat gains a +3 Armor Class bonus against missile attacks from opponents with Dexterity 13 or less.

Bite disease rules.name: Rabies in AD&D
Bite disease rules.effectNote: A bite has a 1% chance per point of damage to cause disease. The printed game rule uses a 1d4+6 day onset and a ten-day survival window after onset. An afflicted character cannot eat or drink. If provoked, a failed Wisdom check makes them attack until killed or knocked unconscious. The entry allows cure disease, wish, limited wish, alter reality, or similar magic to cure it.

notes: 3–18 appearing. The table lists flock organization. Nocturnal and omnivorous.
Uncommon. Animal intelligence (1). Neutral. Unsteady (5–7) morale. Treasure and magic resistance Nil.
The table lists THAC0 19 or 20 without explicitly assigning either value to one of the two HP or HD options.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, third printing (January 1994), pp. 15–16.

name: Mobat
appearance: A huge fanged bat with a twelve- to sixteen-foot wingspan.

Special attacks.name: Silent flight
Special attacks.effectNote: Rapid, silent flight gives its victims a −3 penalty on surprise rolls.

Special attacks.name: Screech
Special attacks.effectNote: If prey resists, the Mobat screeches in a 20-foot radius. Affected victims must save vs. paralyzation or cover their ears instead of fighting.

Habitat and behavior.name: Flight space
Habitat and behavior.effectNote: It needs room to take off and land. The prose describes a preference for warm-blooded prey and an interest in shiny objects.

notes: 1–8 appearing. The table lists flock organization. Nocturnal and omnivorous.
Rare. Low intelligence (5–7). Neutral evil. Steady (11–12) morale. Treasure type C. Magic resistance Nil.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, third printing (January 1994), pp. 15–16.
